sharedSave.generation: Real browser campaign L1-L6 completed once. Its L6-start campaign was replayed through the existing production LevelSixBot complete policy to obtain a larger, actually completed cohort; no god mode or objective hooks.

humanlikeProbe.setup: L10 cure-disperse-ready fixture; normal-health Mega 10 m east of console; charge completed for setup; no god mode.
humanlikeProbe.combat: Physical mouse aim and Space held while visible; WASD retreat; no world writes during combat, no target-ignore timer.

harness: Original tools/playtest restored before exact campaign; diagnostics were isolated copies used only for comparison runs.

l3Replay.change: The later final-tree group-wait HUD shows the actual missing officer distance; no gate or simulation criteria changed.

fullCampaignCommand: npm run playtest -- --levels L1-L10 --quality low --zoom 1.5 --no-skip --out test-results/playtest/batch14-fix
aimFix: Preserve manually led projectile aim when it is closer to the constant-velocity intercept than the current-body snap; automatic target intent keeps its original snap.

supersededPredictiveAttempt.reason: Automatic lead for all projectile attacks regressed the existing L6 complete-policy survivor gate; narrowed to manual aim after baseline and isolated comparison. No test thresholds changed.

l4GuidanceFix.failure: Street turn marker directed straight into reception chair/table corner; held diagonal keys could not escape.
l4GuidanceFix.fix: HUD and mission map share a player-clearance route to the next authored street turn. Route distance and authored path are unchanged.

l10StagingFix.failure: Full-health Mega staged in a nav-clear enclosed factory pocket; visible-input driver could not target it.
l10StagingFix.fix: Choose a point at the authored staging distance with a body-clear segment to the courier; reset hidden/coarse route state.

staleResumeStagger.cause: restoreVitals cleared knockdown but retained absolute combat.staggerUntil, blocking resumed input
staleResumeStagger.fix: clear stagger together with the other transient player vitals

Old versus new campaign outcomes alone do not identify a causal commit: staging depends on the courier offset at charge completion, and these staging/aim defects already existed at the range start.
